name: postgres-viz
description: Capture PostgreSQL dependencies and explore them offline.

scripts.release: node esbuild.mjs && node scripts/build-go.mjs --release && node scripts/package-release.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint viewer editors/vscode scripts test esbuild.mjs
